start.title: Start: {name}
start.picksHint: You choose the people for the steps below.
start.noneHint: Processes an administrator publishes for you show up here.
start.badForm: This process's form cannot be shown, so it cannot be started yet. Ask an administrator to check the form.

decide.delegateHint: Once they have handled it, the task comes back to you to decide.

signHint.before: Once all added signers have approved, the task returns to you for approval.
signHint.after: You approve now; this step completes once all added signers have approved.

decide.withdrawHint: Takes back your approval and the task returns to you; not possible once the next step has been worked on.
decide.cancelHint: The process ends and every pending task is canceled.
decide.resubmitHint: It was sent back to you: resubmit it as it stands and the approval goes on.

urge.done: The current approvers have been reminded
urge.later: You can send a reminder once per hour. Please try again later.
